fusions.name: Quiver of Scales
fusions.desc: Looses a shed scale that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sprung Uncurl
fusions.desc: You uncurl and loose 5 scales in a wide spread, each dealing 9 damage and knocking its target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Loosed Step
fusions.desc: You uncurl and spring 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises by 30% for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Wound Tight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a scale strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
